messages:
maria: FYI putting a proposal here for RBAC/Console changes + KMS audit tweaks. Idea is to remove the implicit "can_view_keys" flag on legacy "viewer" variants and introduce a small "editor-lite" role for teams that need key visibility. Also changing KMS audit events to a structured namespace. Feedback? :eyes:

ashok: TL;DR impact for customers? oops/migration pain?

maria: TL;DR: most users see no change. Admins who relied on implicit key viewing will either be migrated to editor-lite or shown a prompt to request access. Integrations using API tokens with legacy claims keep compat for 30 days, but we emit deprecation headers. Requires minor Console UX gating (hide "View key" kebab for pure viewer) and a migration job to translate legacy flags.

sophie: will this break existing service accounts / API keys used by CI? need a clear rollback plan.

kevin: Not if we add a compatibility shim. Plan: accept legacy_view claim for 30d and return header: "X-RW-Deprecation: legacy_view will be removed in 30d". After 30d tokens without updated claims get 403 for key-read endpoints. We'll document and add SDK helpers.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: rbac-migration-job v1 -> staging @ 2026-04-02T02:00Z :rocket:

security-oncall: Two security requirements: (1) Audit events for KMS decrypt must include key_id and caller_role, but must never include plaintext key material or full principal PII. (2) Create a rate spike alert for decrypts -> attach playbook.

maria: agreed. Draft audit event example below — want to validate fields before we shipping to logs pipeline.

maria: ```json
{
  "event": "audit.kms.decrypt",
  "ts": "2026-04-02T02:01:23Z",
  "actor": {
    "id": "team-457",
    "role": "editor-lite"
  },
  "resource": {
    "key_id": "projects/prod/keys/rgw-abc123",
    "key_alias": "service-account-keys"
  },
  "outcome": "success",
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "rq_9f2a",
    "region": "us-west1"
  }
}
```

ashok: Looks good. Please ensure key_id is hashed/pseudonymized in low-retention exports. We should have both raw_full and redacted views internally; marketing/analytics only get redacted.

security-oncall: also add field "actor_role_before_migration" for the first 30d so auditors can reconcile legacy mappings. And enumerate the data retention window in the schema.

kevin: Will add response header for legacy tokens and a 30d TTL on compatibility. Also coordinate SDK bump to surface deprecation in logs.

maria: action items: (1) i will author migration job + DB backfill draft (PR by Tue). (2) ashok will run staging validation and smoke tests. (3) kevin will push SDK warning update. (4) security-oncall will add decrypt-spike alert + playbook. sophie please test CI service-account flows.

sophie: ack, i'll run integration tests against staging and watch for 403s.

devops-bot: incident created RW-SEC-412: "RBAC migration - staging run" (assignee: ashok)

maria: one more UX note: Console should show an inline banner when an admin views a project with legacy-view accounts: "Some accounts use legacy key-viewing behavior — consider migrating to editor-lite or request approval." button -> request flow. we'll add copy. :lock:

ashok: please include migration rollback: feature flag + plan to re-enable legacy behavior for 48h if we see >0.5% unauthorized responses on key endpoints.

maria: added. i'll open the feature-flag PR and link it in the migration doc. Thanks everyone.

kevin: ping me when PRs are up, i'll coordinate SDK release notes.

security-oncall: i'll draft a brief for compliance auditors summarizing how decrypt events and roles changed.

maria: thanks — closing for now, will post PR links here. :white_check_mark:
